title: Fabulous Colcannon (Mashed Potatoes and Cabbage)
description: This fabulous colcannon (mashed potatoes and cabbage) recipe is a variation on the usual one, with bacon, ham, and mayonnaise added. Top it with cheese.
ingredients: 3 pounds potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
0.5 head cabbage, sliced into thin strips
salt and ground black pepper to taste
2 cups fully cooked ham, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain; transfer to a large bowl.
Stir milk, butter, and mayonnaise into potatoes; mash with a potato masher until smooth.

Cook and stir bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until fat is rendered, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in onion, garlic, and cayenne pepper; cook, stirring often, until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir cabbage and water into bacon-onion mixture until cabbage is wilted, about 5 minutes; season with salt and black pepper. Fold into mashed potatoes.
Cook and stir ham pieces in the same skillet until lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes; stir into mashed potato-cabbage mixture until combined.
